title: Data Engineer
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
As Finance & Procurement Tech department we deliver IT services to our central
Finance staﬀ. For statutory & regulatory reporting purposes we develop and maintain a
financial reporting system (GFRS).
You will be responsible for development of advanced PowerBI reports including the
underlying dataset and data model. These reports support Finance users in analyzing
financial data during their monthly cycle of delivering various mandatory datasets to
As a Data Engineer you will interact with users for requirements as well as with your
Tech colleagues that support and develop the underlying financial reporting system.
•Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power
•Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and
•Collaborate with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate
them into technical solutions
•Ensure delivered dashboards and reports meet expected quality outputs
through conducting testing.•Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and performance across reporting
•Support ad hoc data analysis and reporting needs.
Key Capabilities/Experience
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a similar field
•Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a similar field
•Solid Experience in the reporting tool Power BI.
•Expertise in SQL / RDBMS databases (preferably Oracle), handling of structured
data, including performance tuning.
•Understanding of data modelling concepts
•Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into data
•Extensive experience in design and implementation of data handling processes
(ingestion, transformation, modelling, and storage)
•Experience with Enterprise or Governed Reporting solutions.
•Strong problem solving and solutions engineering mindset.
•Ability to work in a complex environment with large and heterogeneous
•Experience in Agile way of working is a plus.
•Experience in CI / CD and DevOps is a plus.
Minimum Qualifications
•Experience in the reporting tools Power BI.
•Proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, report design).
•Expertise in SQL / RDBMS databases, handling of structured data.
•Experience with Enterprise or Governed Reporting solutions.
•Strong problem solving and solutions engineering mindset.
•Proficiency and experience in programming languages such as Python, shell
•Experience in cloud platforms and technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) is a plus.
